name: Lee Mao
office: City of Diamond Bar, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: Lee Mao is vice chair of the Diamond Bar Planning Commission and a business president. His campaign calls fiscal responsibility essential. He says the city should consider more sheriff patrols, adding license plate readers, and expanding neighborhood watch teams. He says he would attract new businesses. He supports the Downtown Diamond Bar expansion to boost revenue without tax increases. On housing, he supports the Town Center mixed-use development.
